ageGender.title: Young women and older men were removed at higher rates
ageGender.dek: Share of voters struck off before the draft roll, by age group and gender, Karnataka, 2026
ageGender.source: Sources: CEO Karnataka; Mathakaavalu; Diagram Chasing
ageGender.secondNote: From age 40 onward, men's rate is higher

transgender.title: In 155 of 211 constituencies, transgender voters were removed at a higher rate
transgender.dek: Statewide, 45% of registered transgender voters were removed between Jan 2025 and Oct 2026, twice the 22% rate for men and women.
transgender.note: Excludes 13 constituencies with no registered transgender voters.
transgender.source: Sources: CEO Karnataka; Mathakaavalu; Diagram Chasing

sexRatioShift.source: Sources: CEO Karnataka; Mathakaavalu; Diagram Chasing

removalsVsAdditions.title: Additions replaced a fraction of the voters removed before the draft

removalsVsAdditions.source: Sources: CEO Karnataka; Mathakaavalu; Diagram Chasing

lossVsMargin.title: In 158 of 224 constituencies, net voter loss exceeded the 2023 winning margin
